projects.title: SRMD Multilingual Speech Translation
projects.summary: A multilingual speech-translation pipeline for Gujarati spiritual discourse, spanning dataset preparation, model training, and evaluation.
built: Prepared training data and designed evaluation metrics for Gujarati-to-English translation.
Trained the Gujarati-to-English model and evaluated domain-specific vocabulary errors.
Used synthetic examples, human review, baseline comparisons, and an LLM judge to identify errors for review and retraining.
projects.approach: The pipeline combines speech recognition, alignment and translation components built around Whisper and NVIDIA NeMo.
projects.evaluation: An evaluation loop combining synthetic examples, human review, baseline comparisons, and an LLM judge that flagged domain-vocabulary errors for review and retraining.
projects.result: The broader product supports eight languages and has reached 1.2M+ users across 190+ countries. This is product-wide reach, not attributable to my work alone.

projects.title: Wisdom Multimodal Search and RAG
projects.summary: A production multimodal search system spanning webpages, articles, audio, video, and PDFs, with timestamped results for video.

stat.label: click-through rate in the production search experience

built: Combined Voyage embeddings, Weaviate vector retrieval, and BM25 for hybrid search across multiple content types.
Added an in-house timestamping model to locate relevant moments inside video.
Used an LLM reranking stage to refine retrieved results.
projects.approach: Hybrid retrieval using Voyage embeddings, Weaviate and BM25, with an in-house timestamping model and an LLM reranking stage.
projects.result: The system serves 10,000+ monthly users with under 1.5-second median end-to-end latency.

projects.title: Drone Obstacle Avoidance with Selective VLM Reasoning
projects.summary: A simulated drone obstacle-avoidance pipeline that escalates uncertain cases to a vision-language model instead of invoking it on every frame.

stat.label: lower latency than baseline at 95% pipeline accuracy

built: Designed a fast perception stage and risk gate to identify uncertain obstacle detections.
Escalated difficult cases, including wires and glass, to Qwen for deeper visual reasoning.
Evaluated end-to-end accuracy and latency against a baseline on the same workload.
projects.approach: The risk gate escalates uncertain cases to Qwen, which reasons about difficult obstacles such as wires and glass.
projects.result: On the same simulated workload, the selective reasoning path maintained 95% end-to-end pipeline accuracy while reducing latency against the baseline.

projects.title: LLM-Assisted CUDA Kernel Performance Prediction
projects.summary: A hybrid model that predicts CUDA kernel runtime from static code features, LLM-derived semantics, and GPU hardware characteristics.

stat.label: runtime prediction error across 100 CUDA kernels

built: Combined static CUDA code characteristics with LLM-derived semantic features and hardware information.
Evaluated predictions on 100 CUDA kernels run on the NYU cluster.
Compared mean absolute percentage error against a baseline runtime-prediction approach.
projects.evaluation: Evaluated on 100 CUDA kernels run on the NYU cluster.
projects.result: This was a 20% improvement over the baseline runtime-prediction approach.

projects.title: Face Recognition for Community Deployments
projects.summary: An open-source Siamese face-recognition model using ResNet-based embeddings and triplet loss, developed for a community deployment.
built: Trained a Siamese model with ResNet-based embeddings and triplet loss.
Used augmentation and a dataset of Indian faces.
Open-sourced the implementation and mentored contributors through GirlScript Summer of Code.
projects.result: The deployment site had a membership base exceeding 8,000.

projects.title: Prompt Invariant Training (PIT)
projects.summary: Research on making LLM mathematical reasoning more robust to plausible but irrelevant prompt context.
built: Generated adversarial prompt variants that introduced distracting context without changing the underlying question.
Compared standard SFT, Noise-CoT SFT, and latent-aligned fine-tuning on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B.
Measured adversarial accuracy alongside clean-prompt performance to characterize robustness trade-offs.
projects.approach: Compared standard SFT, Noise-CoT SFT, and latent-aligned fine-tuning on a Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B model family.
projects.result: Adversarial reasoning accuracy rose from 21.57% (baseline) to 41.1% with Noise-CoT SFT and 48.3% with latent-aligned fine-tuning, with a slight clean-prompt accuracy trade-off.

projects.title: Physics-Inspired Crowd-Risk Detection
projects.summary: A fluid-mechanics-inspired crowd-risk score that combines density, motion, optical flow, and directional variation to flag potentially dangerous regions.

stat.label: optical-flow endpoint error after fine-tuning RAFT

built: Combined density, motion, optical flow, and directional variation into a per-region risk signal.
Fine-tuned RAFT optical flow on CrowdFlow and evaluated endpoint error on held-out data.
projects.approach: Borrows ideas from fluid mechanics to turn per-region density and flow fields into a single risk signal.
projects.result: Reduced endpoint error from 1.110 to 0.5644 on held-out evaluation data.

experiences.title: Data Analytics Intern
bullets: Built a hybrid claims-classification pipeline combining description embeddings and logistic regression with a prompt-tuned Gemma 4 fallback for low-confidence or conflicting predictions. Across 11,000 records, it reached 99% accuracy and approximately 89% PR-AUC.
Built an embeddings-and-HDBSCAN workflow to group semantically similar claims, then reviewed noise clusters and tuned thresholds to support claim-category loss-ratio analysis across MGAs.
Trained a Random Forest model to predict one-year loan delinquency from monthly loan data using a time-based split, reaching 91% accuracy.
experiences.summary: Applied NLP and machine learning to insurance claims and lending data, supporting risk classification and portfolio-level analysis.

experiences.title: Co-Founder and Founding Engineer
bullets: Built a Python SDK with callback-based instrumentation to capture application traces with minimal changes to existing application logic.
Developed a dashboard connecting traces, test cases, expected outputs, and observed outputs to surface behavioral drift across model, prompt, and configuration changes.
Implemented golden test suites, custom tests, repeatable evaluations, and persona-driven simulations covering 10+ attack and failure scenarios.
Worked with five active users across organizations and incorporated framework-compatibility feedback into the SDK.
experiences.summary: Co-founding an open-source evaluation platform to detect behavioral regressions in LLM applications and agentic systems, initially focused on AI risk assessment and insurability.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Built an automated red-teaming framework using Llama 3.1 and Phi-3.5 Mini to generate, execute, and score adversarial prompts against OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications.
Designed a five-point severity-grading workflow with human-reviewed ground truth, reducing assessment effort from roughly eight hours of manual testing to under five hours of reviewer time.

Built a website security-scoring pipeline using a locally deployed Gemma 3 27B model to screen webpage text and screenshots for potential exposure of user information; screened 10,000+ domains and generated concise reports for CISO review.
experiences.summary: Developed AI security testing and privacy-screening systems for adversarial chatbot behavior and potential exposure of sensitive information.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Built a music-recommendation workflow combining facial embeddings, speech-derived features, and text sentiment, with a meta-audio model generating a tone aligned with each recommendation. Evaluation by 50 users yielded 84% recommendation quality, while latency fell 40% relative to the prior implementation.

Developed a handwritten-document OCR pipeline evaluated across 100,000+ documents, reaching 87% extraction accuracy through augmentation and region-specific labels for tick-mark localization and category mapping.
experiences.summary: Built multimodal ML pipelines for personalized recommendations and document understanding.

about: I'm an MS Computer Science student at NYU Courant focused on reliable AI systems, multimodal retrieval, computer vision, and GPU performance.

My work spans production ML systems, LLM evaluation infrastructure, and research into robustness and performance. I enjoy building systems where model quality, reliability, and practical constraints all matter.
I'm especially interested in technology that is useful at scale, from multilingual speech translation to tools that make AI systems easier to evaluate and trust.

coursework: Computer Vision for Science and Engineering
